lines.text: “I paid on the 20th. Here's my screenshot.” Free OCR with rules grabs two hundred eighty-eight thousand three hundred won: the card bill. Nemotron picks the payment to the shop. The ledger has no payment at that time.

Here it is in the app. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, on Nebius Token Factory, reads the photo, and the payment provider's ledger decides. A wrong date, or an edited one? The model can't tell. The ledger can check, without accusing anyone.

The reply asks politely, and the customer answers: “Sorry, it was the 19th.” Nemotron 3.5 Lightning reads the answer and the agent checks again. A real payment from this customer exists on the 19th, so now it matches.
The money chain shows where it really stopped: the credits arrived, but the email never went out. The reply is rewritten, and the fix waits for the seller to approve.
On sixteen held-out phone photos made by a separate agent, Nemotron read the payment and reached the right verdict on fourteen. Free OCR with rules: three.
Messages are messy too. Two addresses: his wife's, and the one he paid with.
Nemotron 3.5 Lightning reads the message: who is writing and which records to look up. Addresses are masked first, and anything the message doesn't say is dropped.
A verifier, not the model, walks the chain. The order was saved under a typo, exmaple dot com, and the mail bounced.
Every call is on screen: which Nemotron did which job, the time, the tokens and the cost. Ultra re-reads when the first reading is unsure, which on Korean threads was most of the time.
Approve, and the fix runs. On the public demo, only your own copy of the data changes.
Ask for someone else's order number, and it is not read. And when nothing was charged, it says so. Nothing is broken. You were never charged.
On twenty-two Korean-heavy messages, Nemotron found who was writing in twenty; rules alone, sixteen. When it could not tell, as in an attack, nobody's records were read. The README lists every miss.
All data here is synthetic; real customer photos are not measured yet. Paid, but nothing arrived? Now you can show the customer where the money stopped. NVIDIA Nemotron, on Nebius Token Factory.
